latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of radio-copilot skill, designed for planning and alerting on NOAA APT, METEOR LRPT, and ISS satellite passes for SDR reception.
- Predicts and alerts on satellite passes for a set latitude/longitude, including manual dish alignment information (AOS/LOS azimuth/elevation, track direction, inclination).
- Supports configuration of NORAD IDs, minimum elevation, alert lead time, and capture/decode automation hooks.
- Integrates with WhatsApp for pass alert notifications.
- Zero-AI operation by default; SDR capture and decode automation hooks provided but disabled until configured.
